## Problem

What was wrong, and where (page, component, contract call). Link the task.

## Change

What this PR changes. If it differs from what the task asked for, say so and why.

## How it was verified

- [ ] Typecheck and lint pass (the Checks workflow runs them on this PR)
- [ ] Tried in the app: steps, network, and wallet used
- [ ] Checked against the contract or subgraph when the change depends on on-chain behaviour

## Left open

Anything not done, known limits, or follow-ups. Write "None" if nothing is open.

## Retest

Who should retest after merge, and what to check. Merging to master deploys to app.dex223.io.
